lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Person of Interest,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: how is Anis doing?
She's doing well.
Couldn't be better, honestly.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I see.
Do you need her for anything?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Nothing in particular.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I was just curious.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Not sure if you know this,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: but I've actually been a fan of Anis for a long time.
Why not just text her yourself?
I'm sure she'd be happy to hear from you.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: That might be a bit difficult.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Fans are at their best when they stay fans.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: If we start contacting each other personally,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: it kind of crosses the line between fan and star.
I think that'll be fine.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: If it's work-related, then yes.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: But anything beyond that...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It's not what I consider an ideal relationship between a fan and a pop star.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Please just think of it as a personal preference.
Then can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: What would you like to know?
I was just curious
what made you start liking Anis.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Oh, that?

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I like everything about her!

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: The way her voice sounds so bright and refreshing when she sings,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: and she's really cute when she dances too.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Her easygoing personality

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: just makes her even more likable.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: When she first performed on a music show,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: she was so nervous that you could tell right away.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You really had to see it

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: to understand how adorable she was back then.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: But by her next performance,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: she was already so much more professional.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: She even mixed up the first and second verses

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: and just played it off

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: It was really impressive!

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Even I didn't notice at first, and I know all the lyrics.
Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Sorry,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I got a bit carried away.
No, it was nice seeing a new side of you.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: What do you mean?
I had you pegged as the mature type,
so seeing you get all excited like a kid caught me off guard. Not gonna lie, it was cute.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Right...

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: You probably understand Anis's strengths

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: better than anyone,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: so I got a bit carried away.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you could forget that.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: Now that I think about it, that was a bit embarrassing.
I'll try, but no promises lol.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I still have some work to finish up,

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: so I'll head off for now.

lines.speaker: avistar
lines.text: I'll message you again later.
